lines.en: There's something special about Tsukioka Manor. But if you asked me to tell you what it is, I'd probably just point my finger at the creature in front of me.
lines.zh: Tsukioka 公馆有某种特别之处。但你要是让我说出那是什么,我大概只会抬手指向我面前这个生物。

lines.en: Which isn't to say Tsubasa's daughters aren't just as special as she is, but they possess only a fraction of the terrifying yet arousing aura I'm experiencing right now.
lines.zh: 这并不是说 Tsubasa 的女儿们不像她那样特别,而是她们只具备我此刻感受到的这种恐怖又撩人气息的一小部分。

lines.en: In terms of what makes this place what it is, though, I see no reason to look any further than the opposite side of this desk.
lines.zh: 不过,要论是什么造就了此地,我没必要再往别处看——这张桌子的对面就是答案。

lines.en: Tsubasa isn't what I thought she was at first. She's no stereotypical lord's wife, nor a woman who's simply skating by due to what she's acquired since birth.
lines.zh: Tsubasa 不是我最初以为的样子。她不是刻板印象里的领主夫人,也不是仅凭与生俱来的家产混日子的女人。

lines.en: And any time I'm with her, I need to pay extra attention to my strings.
lines.zh: 而每当我和她在一起,我都得多留意自己的提线。

lines.en: I'm not quite sure why I came here tonight apart from the fact that she wanted me to. And I'm not quite sure what I've gained from doing so.
lines.zh: 除了她想让我来,我不太确定自己今晚为什么来这里。我也不太确定这么做让我得到了什么。

lines.en: But I feel closer to God than I did the night before. And the reason for that is simple.
lines.zh: 但比起昨夜,我感觉离神更近了。原因很简单。

lines.en: There's something special about Tsukioka Manor.
lines.zh: Tsukioka 公馆有某种特别之处。

lines.en: And you can hear it for yourself if you stop focusing on all of the other sounds.
lines.zh: 而只要你不再留意其他的声音,就能亲耳听见它。
Tsubasa 的好感度提升到了 [tsubasa_love]!
